def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==3]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    ci=(r0+r1)//2; cj=(c0+c1)//2
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            if g[i][j]==3:
                out[i][j]=3
            elif i==ci and j==cj:
                out[i][j]=3
            else:
                d=min(i-r0,r1-i,j-c0,c1-j)
                out[i][j]=4 if d%2==1 else 2
    return out
